confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for a July 2026 window, not based on live listings or menus. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because seasonal rates vary. FX caveat: the 2026-10-15 observation came from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange rates overview page, which I did not open directly, and the 4pm Sydney fix for that day may not have been published when this was generated. Verify against rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to mid-sized Central and Eastern European capitals with similar pricing and tourism demand, such as Sofia, Budapest and Belgrade. Beer, cocktail and wine are set on the usual local price relationship: cocktail at about three times beer, and a restaurant wine glass at about 1.5 times beer.
